item.text: {"role":"structure","inspection_scope":"Complete supplied film plan reviewed as data: script, single rhetorical chapter, setup s1, beat b1, planned dominant actions, before/after states, hierarchy, continuity tokens, and reset logic.","checks":[{"check":"METAPHOR_OVERLOAD","status":"FAIL","evidence":"Setup s1 combines three unrelated mechanisms in one physical world: candidate selection, an independent cost-stack collapse, and bug-scanner findings. Only selection serves the sole proposition, “This answer is selected.”"},{"check":"STATE_ACCUMULATION_WITHOUT_MEANING","status":"PASS","evidence":"The plan contains one beat and does not describe obsolete mechanisms persisting as later claims arrive. The unrelated mechanisms are simultaneous, not accumulated historical state."},{"check":"SEMANTIC_GROUP_OVERLOAD","status":"FAIL","evidence":"Beat b1 explicitly gives equal size and activity to three unrelated result groups—selection, cost, and bug discovery—and changes all three together."},{"check":"COMPOSITIONAL_STAGNATION","status":"PASS","evidence":"There is only one setup and one beat, so no sequence of unrelated propositions repeating the same framing is present."},{"check":"CONTINUITY_TOKEN_OVERLOAD","status":"PASS","evidence":"No continuity tokens are planned, so no persistent token lifecycle obscures the story."},{"check":"CLUTTER_WITHOUT_PURPOSE","status":"FAIL","evidence":"The cost pile and bug scanner have no story, location, balance, or causal function supporting the sole selection proposition; they are retained expressly to keep the frame energetic."},{"check":"WEAK_RESET_RHYTHM","status":"PASS","evidence":"The script contains one proposition and ends after one setup. No semantic shift occurs that would require an intermediate reset."},{"check":"COMPETING_FOCI","status":"FAIL","evidence":"The contract specifies three equal thirds that “all insist on equal attention,” while the before and after states keep three unrelated large active regions. The candidate cannot command the planned glance hierarchy."},{"check":"CAPTION_CARRIES_STORY","status":"PASS","evidence":"The central action itself shows selection: Bot selects the candidate and the chosen sheet rises above alternatives. The caption identifies the spoken object but is not the sole carrier of the selection meaning."}],"setup_assessments":[{"setup_id":"s1","status":"FAIL","evidence":"Its selection rule is diluted by equally dominant cost-collapse and bug-scanning mechanisms that are unrelated to the narration and compete throughout the setup."}],"violations":[{"code":"METAPHOR_OVERLOAD","setup_ids":["s1"],"observation":"One setup asks a shared paper-workspace world to express selection, cost burden, and bug inspection simultaneously, despite the script containing only the selection claim.","smallest_structural_correction":"Remove the cost stack and bug scanner from s1, leaving a selection world in which the chosen candidate visibly separates from or replaces its alternatives."},{"code":"SEMANTIC_GROUP_OVERLOAD","setup_ids":["s1"],"observation":"Three unrelated dominant groups are equally large, active, and result-bearing in b1.","smallest_structural_correction":"Make the candidate group the only dominant semantic group; eliminate the independent cost and scanner groups rather than merely shrinking or recoloring them."},{"code":"CLUTTER_WITHOUT_PURPOSE","setup_ids":["s1"],"observation":"The cost pile and scanner do not support the stated selection, environment, or causal result; the persistence rationale identifies generic energy as their purpose.","smallest_structural_correction":"Delete both unrelated mechanisms and retain only environmental supports needed to stage the candidate selection."},{"code":"COMPETING_FOCI","setup_ids":["s1"],"observation":"The planned three-equal-thirds composition and simultaneous changes prevent the candidate sheet from controlling attention.","smallest_structural_correction":"Recompose around one dominant candidate-selection contact and its alternatives, with any support subordinate and causally tied to that action."}],"limits":"This data-only review can assess planned structure and hierarchy but cannot establish rendered visibility, actual mobile-glance performance, final artwork quality, motion execution, or listening experience."}
